subject: Etched in Steven Clark's memory are the protruding teeth and moustache of the driver he says picked him up as a teenager.
posts: Memory is a fragile witness, yet it is all we have when the truth is buried in the past. The inquiry seeks to bridge the gap. #Aletheia #Justice
The claim is that the inquiry is a pursuit of truth regarding past atrocities. Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good
The reality is that the inquiry is actively uncovering long-buried systemic failures. Resulting Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good
Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace. The inquiry is a necessary, if painful, act of historical reckoning.
The NSW missing persons inquiry is examining testimony linking Ivan Milat to the disappearance of a teenage hitchhiker, Steven Clark.

The Bright Side:
Even decades later, the pursuit of truth provides a form of justice that can help heal the wounds of the past.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here. The WHO, WHAT, and WHY are aligned in the pursuit of historical accountability.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the gap between the past silence and the current inquiry...
...it plots a trajectory toward Greater Good. The active effort to resolve the past creates value for the present.

The Unavoidable Truth: The truth does not expire, no matter how much time passes.

The Unavoidable Lie: That some secrets are better left buried for the sake of peace.

Historical accountability is the only way to ensure systemic failures are not repeated. This inquiry is a vital function of the state.
